lead: Elvis Presley was an American singer, born on 8 January 1935 in Tupelo.
He died on 16 August 1977 in Memphis at the age of 42.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award and Gospel Music Hall of Fame.
This profile collects the Elvis facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Elvis Presley — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Elvis Presley was born on 8 January 1935 in Tupelo, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Elvis Aaron Presley at birth and is publicly known as Elvis Presley.
Public records name his father, Vernon Presley and his mother, Gladys Presley. He is a sibling of Jessie Garon Presley.
He received his education at Humes Preparatory Academy Middle School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Elvis Presley — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists singer as his main occupation.
He performs on guitar, piano, voice and bass guitar.

sections.heading: Elvis Presley — Family, Marriage and Personal Life

He is a parent to Lisa Marie Presley.

sections.heading: Elvis Presley — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Elvis Presley circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.
What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a singer, brand partnerships and sponsored social content.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.

faq.a: His birth name is Elvis Aaron Presley; he is publicly known as Elvis Presley.
Elvis Presley was born in Tupelo and holds American nationality.
